Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes Total time: 35 minutes Number of Servings: 7 Ingredients 1 cup tomato pasta sauce (store-bought or homemade) 1 pound chicken breast, cut or pounded into 1/2-inch thick slices 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper 1 package (10 ounces) frozen spinach, thawed and drained or 4 cups fresh spinach leaves 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Preheat oven to 350 °F. Pour 1/2 cup of pasta sauce in a large baking dish. Lay the chicken pieces over the sauce, then sprinkle salt and pepper on the chicken. Top with remaining 1/2 cup of pasta sauce, spinach and mozzarella. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (165 °F using a food thermometer) and the cheese begins to turn brown. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Do not rinse raw poultry. Wash hands and all surfaces and utensils after touching raw chicken. Try other fresh or frozen and thawed leafy greens.
